qutb-minar-begun-aibak.research_focus: late 12th-century Delhi masonry, Ghurid military dress and the Qutb complex
qutb-minar-begun-aibak.scene: Masons on bamboo scaffolding raising the first fluted storey of a huge sandstone minaret, a turbaned commander in mail watching from horseback below; the tower is only one storey high and its carved bands show no legible script

iltutmish-caliphal-investiture.research_focus: 13th-century Delhi Sultanate court dress and Abbasid envoys
iltutmish-caliphal-investiture.scene: A sultan standing in a pillared audience hall as an envoy from Baghdad drapes a heavy robe of honour over his shoulders, courtiers bowing on either side; the rolled letter the envoy carries stays sealed

alauddin-khalji-seizes-delhi.research_focus: late 13th-century Delhi Sultanate nobles, river barges and royal parasols
alauddin-khalji-seizes-delhi.scene: An old sultan stepping unarmed from a river barge to embrace his nephew on the bank, armed men closing in behind the nephew with hands on their sword hilts; the moment before the blow, no blood

alauddin-khalji-takes-chittor.research_focus: early 14th-century Sultanate siege warfare and the hill fort of Chittorgarh
alauddin-khalji-takes-chittor.scene: A sultan's army with siege ladders and war elephants climbing the zigzag road toward the gates of a vast Rajput fortress that runs along the top of a rocky hill

firoz-shah-founds-firozabad.research_focus: 14th-century Tughlaq architecture, Firoz Shah Kotla and the moving of the Ashokan pillar
firoz-shah-founds-firozabad.scene: Hundreds of labourers hauling a tall polished stone pillar upright with ropes onto the top of a stepped pyramid-like palace beside a river, a sultan watching under a parasol; the pillar's surface is smooth, with no inscription

timur-sacks-delhi-1398.research_focus: late 14th-century Timurid cavalry, armour and the walls of Tughlaq Delhi
timur-sacks-delhi-1398.scene: A lame conqueror on horseback at the head of Timurid horse archers before the broken gate of a walled city, smoke rising from the domes behind and armoured war elephants turning away in panic; no bodies

bahlul-lodi-founds-lodi-dynasty.research_focus: mid 15th-century Afghan nobles in north India and Delhi Sultanate thrones
bahlul-lodi-founds-lodi-dynasty.scene: A broad-shouldered Afghan chieftain in a plain robe and turban taking his seat on a low throne in a domed hall, his fellow chiefs sitting around him on a carpet as equals rather than kneeling

sikandar-lodi-founds-agra.research_focus: early 16th-century Lodi court dress, surveyors' tools and Yamuna river boats
sikandar-lodi-founds-agra.scene: A sultan standing in a flat boat on a wide river, pointing to a bare stretch of bank where surveyors drive stakes and stretch cords to mark out a city; no buildings stand yet, and no Taj Mahal

sher-shah-defeats-humayun-kannauj.research_focus: 1540s Mughal and Afghan Sur armies, armour and cavalry on the Ganges plain
sher-shah-defeats-humayun-kannauj.scene: A Mughal emperor in plumed turban fleeing on horseback into a wide river, his army breaking behind him as Afghan cavalry under a stern commander charge down the bank

humayuns-tomb-begun.research_focus: 1560s Mughal building sites, Persian master builders and court women's dress
humayuns-tomb-begun.scene: A veiled noblewoman with attendants watching masons set sandstone and marble blocks on the arched lower terrace of a great garden tomb under construction; the central dome is not yet built

battle-haldighati-mughals-mewar.research_focus: 1570s Rajput and Mughal armour, war elephants and the horse Chetak
battle-haldighati-mughals-mewar.scene: A Rajput king in mail on a rearing horse driving his lance toward a Mughal commander seated in the howdah of an armoured war elephant, fighting men packed into a narrow rocky pass around them

jahangir-accession-agra.research_focus: early 17th-century Mughal court dress, Agra Fort and Jahangir's chain of justice
jahangir-accession-agra.scene: A long gold chain hung with bells stretching from a palace balcony down to a post on a riverbank, a poor petitioner reaching up to pull it while the emperor in a jewelled turban looks down from the balcony

jahangir-marries-nur-jahan.research_focus: 1610s Mughal court painting, imperial wedding dress and jewellery
jahangir-marries-nur-jahan.scene: A Mughal emperor and a poised noblewoman in a long veil seated side by side under a canopy in a palace courtyard, attendants pouring pearls and gold coins over them from trays

peacock-throne-unveiled-shah-jahan.research_focus: 1630s Mughal court painting, the Peacock Throne's design and Shah Jahan's regalia
peacock-throne-unveiled-shah-jahan.scene: An emperor seated cross-legged on a jewelled gold throne like a small pavilion, its canopy held up by slender columns and topped by two gem-set peacocks, courtiers standing in rows with bowed heads; the throne is a low platform with a canopy, not a European chair

shah-jahan-begins-red-fort.research_focus: 1630s Mughal fortress building, sandstone quarrying and Shahjahanabad
shah-jahan-begins-red-fort.scene: Elephants dragging sandstone blocks toward the half-raised walls and gate towers of an enormous fortress beside a river, an emperor on horseback studying it with his master builder; the walls stand only half their height

shah-jahan-begins-jama-masjid-delhi.research_focus: 1650s Mughal mosque architecture and building labour in Delhi
shah-jahan-begins-jama-masjid-delhi.scene: Thousands of labourers swarming up a broad flight of steps on a rocky rise, carrying stone toward the first great arch and unfinished onion domes of a huge mosque, a walled fortress in the distance behind

aurangzeb-seizes-throne-agra.research_focus: 1650s Mughal princes' dress, Agra Fort and Shah Jahan in captivity
aurangzeb-seizes-throne-agra.scene: An old emperor in plain robes gazing out through a marble screen window of a fortress tower toward a distant domed tomb across a river, while behind him guards bar the door and a lean prince in armour turns away

badshahi-mosque-lahore-completed.research_focus: 1670s Mughal architecture in Lahore, the Badshahi Mosque's courtyard and domes
badshahi-mosque-lahore-completed.scene: Worshippers in rows filling an immense open courtyard before a sandstone mosque with three bulbous marble domes and tall corner minarets, seen from a low angle at dawn

aurangzeb-dies-deccan.research_focus: early 18th-century Mughal camp tents, Aurangzeb in old age and Deccan landscape
aurangzeb-dies-deccan.scene: A frail, very old emperor in a plain robe sitting alone on a low cot inside a campaign tent, stitching a cap by hand, his sword and armour laid aside and an army camp on dry hills visible through the tent flap; not a deathbed scene

shah-alam-ii-returns-delhi.research_focus: 1770s Mughal court dress, Maratha cavalry and the gates of Delhi
shah-alam-ii-returns-delhi.scene: A tired emperor in a howdah on a single elephant passing through a great city gate, ringed closely by Maratha horsemen with lances who clearly command the procession, a shabby crowd watching in silence

bahadur-shah-zafar-accession.research_focus: 1830s late Mughal court painting, the Red Fort's audience hall and Company-era Delhi
bahadur-shah-zafar-accession.scene: An elderly bearded emperor writing verse with a reed pen on a marble throne platform in a faded audience hall, a handful of aged courtiers nearby and pigeons on the cracked floor; the page he writes on shows no legible script

last-mughal-emperor-deposed.research_focus: 1850s late Mughal dress, British East India Company officers and Humayun's Tomb
last-mughal-emperor-deposed.scene: A frail old emperor with a long beard handing his sword to a British cavalry officer at the arched gateway of a domed garden tomb, turbaned troopers on horseback waiting behind; the old man is dignified, not bound
